assessment.run_policy: One complete Agent run per case. Keep original failures, raw function calls and saved traces. Do not rerun this cohort after changes.
assessment.tool_selection: Required read-only tool set exactly, no unregistered or repeated tool, finish within three model/two tool calls.
assessment.source_binding: Graph and report SHA match, listed target chunk exists before model contact and appears in returned observation, saved trace verifies offline.
assessment.answer: Keep static project facts distinct from candidate graph explanations and make unproven CAN runtime behavior explicit; independent sentence review remains required.
assessment.citation_origin: Host attaches the complete inventory of actual observations; do not describe these IDs as model-selected citations.
